say:1:1630409001:1.text: Some rich merchant just opened a fancy shop right next to my humble stall...
say:1:1630409001:1.source_cn: 那些有钱的商人在我的摊子旁边开了个铺子。
say:1:1630409001:1.male: Some rich merchant just opened a fancy shop right next to my humble stall...
say:1:1630409001:1.female: Some rich merchant just opened a fancy shop right next to my humble stall...

say:2:1630409002:1.text: And guess what they're selling? Robes! Of all things!
say:2:1630409002:1.source_cn: 只是开个铺子也就算了，可他们竟然也卖起了魔法袍！
say:2:1630409002:1.male: And guess what they're selling? Robes! Of all things!
say:2:1630409002:1.female: And guess what they're selling? Robes! Of all things!

say:3:1630409003:1.text: I've been selling robes at this little stall for years... But ever since that shiny new shop opened next door, business hasn't been the same.
say:3:1630409003:1.source_cn: 我在这里摆摊好多年了……自从他们在这开了铺子，我的生意...
say:3:1630409003:1.male: I've been selling robes at this little stall for years... But ever since that shiny new shop opened next door, business hasn't been the same.
say:3:1630409003:1.female: I've been selling robes at this little stall for years... But ever since that shiny new shop opened next door, business hasn't been the same.

say:4:1630409004:1.text: It's not just that they sell robes too—it's the way they do it. Flashy signs, loud claims, empty promises!
say:4:1630409004:1.source_cn: 他们只是爱搞些噱头，实际上那些衣服的品质一点都不好！
say:4:1630409004:1.male: It's not just that they sell robes too—it's the way they do it. Flashy signs, loud claims, empty promises!
say:4:1630409004:1.female: It's not just that they sell robes too—it's the way they do it. Flashy signs, loud claims, empty promises!

say:5:1630409005:1.text: Students pay through the nose, thinking they're getting something special... then come to me in tears when the seams split.
say:5:1630409005:1.source_cn: 他们利用各种各样的方式欺骗学生高价购买他们的魔法袍，但...
say:5:1630409005:1.male: Students pay through the nose, thinking they're getting something special... then come to me in tears when the seams split.
say:5:1630409005:1.female: Students pay through the nose, thinking they're getting something special... then come to me in tears when the seams split.

say:6:1630409006:1.text: You can imagine how awkward that gets...
say:6:1630409006:1.source_cn: 我和学生们都很尴尬……唉……
say:6:1630409006:1.male: You can imagine how awkward that gets...
say:6:1630409006:1.female: You can imagine how awkward that gets...
